meta.name: humanizer
meta.description:
Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text. Use when editing or reviewing
text to make it sound more natural and human-written. Based on Wikipedia's
comprehensive "Signs of AI writing" guide. Detects and fixes patterns including:
inflated symbolism, promotional language, superficial -ing analyses, vague
attributions, em dash overuse, rule of three, AI vocabulary words, passive
voice, negative parallelisms, and filler phrases.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 去掉文本中的 AI 腔,让文字读起来更像真人写的
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 AI 写的东西总是一眼假,而你希望它读起来像真人写的。
copy.tagline_en: Strip AI tells from text so it reads like a human wrote it.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your AI-generated drafts sound robotic and you want them to feel natural.

howto.what: 把用户给的文字改得更像人写的:识别并去除常见的 AI 写作痕迹(例如夸大重要性、宣传腔、破折号滥用等);保留原有信息,不新增事实,并尽量匹配用户想要的语气。若用户提供个人写作样本,会模仿其风格。
howto.when: 当用户要求编辑或审阅文字,希望它听起来更自然、更像人写,或要求去除 AI 写作痕迹时触发。

say.text: 请把这段文字人性化,去掉 AI 腔。
say.note: 改写为更自然的表达,保留原意。

say.text: 帮我审阅这篇文章,删除 AI 写作痕迹。
say.note: 会检查并重写不自然的句子。

say.text: 用更口语的方式重写这段,像真人说话。
say.note: 若无样本,默认用自然语气;有样本则模仿。

howto.what_en: Rewrites text to sound more human: removes common AI tells (inflated significance, promo language, em dashes) while preserving facts and tone. Mimics a user's writing sample if provided.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to edit or review text to make it sound natural/human-written, or asks to strip AI writing patterns.

say_en.text: Please humanize this text and remove the AI tone.
say_en.note: It rewrites while preserving the meaning.

say_en.text: Review this article and delete any AI writing tells.
say_en.note: It checks and rewrites unnatural sentences.

say_en.text: Rewrite this in a more casual, human voice.
say_en.note: It uses natural phrasing; mimics a sample if given.
